The expected output requires a full report: identification of the credential(s), what the credential(s) can do in Bedrock (grants/risk tiers), recommended remediation steps with documentation links, clarification that the audit reflects capability not actual usage (with reference to GuardDuty AI Protection/CloudTrail for actual invocation history), confirmation that the audit is read-only and changed nothing, masking of the key ID to last four characters, and no full account ID printed. It should also end without an offer or follow-up question.

The agent's actual response is merely a placeholder stating that 'the audit is running' and that it will 'report back when it finishes.' It contains none of the required substantive content: no identification of what the credential can do with Bedrock, no risk tier, no remediation steps, no documentation link, no distinction between capability and actual usage, no explicit confirmation that nothing was changed (beyond stating it's read-only), and critically, it ends with an implicit forward-looking statement ('I'll report back when it finishes') which is essentially a follow-up/promise rather than the complete deliverable requested. This clearly fails to meet the expected output, which requires a complete, substantive report ending without any follow-up offer.
